ShareSkills.Title: Data Science with Big Data Analytics
ShareSkills.Description: Learn how data science techniques are applied to big data environments This course covers the fundamentals of distributed data storage parallel processing and analytics using tools such as Hadoop Spark and Hive Students will gain hands on experience building scalable pipelines and applying machine learning models to large datasets
